Field 2.Description: Protocol field 'bacnet_sc_failover_hub_uri'. Layer: asdu. Role: address. Type: string. Field 2.Implementation constraints: stack buffers sized to accomodate 255-byte string plus null terminator, parser stops at first null byte in local copy, BACnet character-string type requires first octet to hold length (max 255 octets), no padding required beyond length octet
